title: Weird colors to put together.
text: Weird colors to put together.. These have a turd brown stripe on them. It wasn’t as clear on line what color it was.  Not nearly as cute on line as in person. Oh well. There are 6 waffle hand towels in this. No off smell. Stitching is actually pretty good.

product_metadata.title: Goroly Home 6 Pack 100% Cotton Farmhouse Vintage Dish Towels Tea Towels Highly Absorbent Quick Dry Professional Grade with Hanging Loop - Stripes - 18x28 Inch - Royal Blue White
features: 6 Kitchen towels measuring 18x28 inch with hanging loop
Highly absorbent and eco friendly dish towels for cleaning. Cotton may shrink by nature after wash.
Perfect gift for thanksgiving dinner parties, Christmas, Mother's Day, birthdays, new year party or housewarming.
Machine wash and tumble dry on low for best results; wash separately on first use. Low iron if needed.
These towels are alternative of a paper towel and you can save paper, save tree by using these reusable kitchen towels.
